overview_description.description: Winter offers an embeddable checkout widget designed to sell NFTs via credit card. Their products include fiat checkout, nft, apis, wallets, and cross-chain payments. Their widget enables businesses to safely store, transfer, and manage a user's NFT if they do not have a wallet.
